units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 27">Gen. R. s. 27</cite> <he>היו מביאין א׳ ושף וכ׳</he> (read <he>ושפין</he>) they would take balsam and smear it on the stones (of the houses of the wealthy); Y. Shebi. V, 55ᵈ bot. <he>רושמין בא׳</he> marked out with balsam. Y. Hor. III, 47ᶜ <he>באפי בלסמון</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>, beg. <he>אפופל׳</he>, <he>אפופילסימון</he> (corr. acc.). V. <cite ref="A02832"><he>אֲפַרְסָמוֹן</he></cite>.
